q: What EcoVadis score do I need for a bronze, silver or gold medal?
title: EcoVadis medal: what score do you need?
short: For scorecards published in October 2026: Platinum 88, Gold 82, Silver 75, Bronze 66. EcoVadis sets these each month from percentiles, so the month your scorecard is published decides the cut-off, not the day you submitted. A theme score below 30 rules out a medal, whatever your total.
audience: Indian MSME exporters whose buyer asks for an EcoVadis medal

p: Medals go by percentile rank against every company EcoVadis rated in the previous 12 months, across all industries: Bronze is the top 35%, Silver top 15%, Gold top 5%, Platinum top 1%. On the first day of each month EcoVadis turns those percentiles into minimum scores and publishes them.

October 2026, from data taken on 1 October: Platinum 88, Gold 82, Silver 75, Bronze 66. Scorecards published later in the month can need a slightly different score, because new assessments keep arriving.

Your scorecard is usually published 6 to 8 weeks after you submit, so a questionnaire sent in early September is judged against October's thresholds. A medal, once awarded, stays valid for 12 months even if the thresholds rise later.
The score itself is absolute, 0 to 100, and EcoVadis gives it a label: Insufficient 0 to 24, Partial 25 to 44, Good 45 to 64, Advanced 65 to 84, Outstanding 85 to 100.

sections.h: The rules that block a medal even with a high total
ul: Any theme below 30: Environment, Labor and Human Rights, Ethics or Sustainable Procurement. A strong environment score cannot carry a weak ethics score.
Bad press: a 360 Watch score of 0 in one theme, or 25 in two, unless you have had no negative finding in the past 3 years (5 years for Ethics).
Excluded businesses: tobacco, weapons, coal or lignite mining, and companies with more than 20% of revenue from coal, among others.
The medal belongs to the rated company only. Your parent, sister company or another plant cannot use it.

sections.h: If you fall short of Bronze
p: EcoVadis has two badges for companies without a medal. Committed needs a score of at least 45. Fast Mover needs 34 to 44 with a gain of at least 6 points on your previous assessment within 18 months. Both are valid for 12 months, like the medal.

sections.h: Small firms are not scored like multinationals
p: EcoVadis adds a size factor to each theme score: +13.75 for companies with 1 to 25 employees, +15 for 26 to 99, +10 for 100 to 999, and nothing for 1,000 or more. A 60-person forging unit needs fewer formal systems than a company of 1,000 or more to reach the same score.

sections.h: Check what your buyer actually wants before you chase a medal
ol: Ask whether the requirement is a medal, a minimum score, or simply a published scorecard shared with them.
If they only need to see the scorecard inside EcoVadis, the medal image may not matter to them. Public use of a medal or badge needs a Premium, Select or Corporate plan.
Find your weakest theme first. Lifting it above 30 matters more than adding points where you are already strong.

example.title: A 70-person auto parts supplier in Pune
lines: Overall score 52, after EcoVadis weights the themes for your industry: label Good.
Against October 2026 thresholds, 52 is 14 points short of Bronze at 66.
Theme scores: Environment 66, Ethics 52, Sustainable Procurement 41, Labor and Human Rights 28.
Labor and Human Rights is below 30, so no medal even with a higher total.
Score 52 is above 45, so the Committed badge is open, if the other badge rules are met.
Fix for next time: a dated health and safety policy, training records and an incident log could lift Labor above 30.
example.note: Scores are invented to show how the rules combine; EcoVadis applies them, with that month's thresholds, at publication.

senseible: Senseible cannot promise a medal, and its checks are not third-party verification. It can calculate each energy and emissions figure from a bill you attach, and its team can draft your Environment answers from those records for you to review and submit.
